title: How to Generate AI Videos in Claude With the Higgsfield MCP Connector (2026)
snippet:
To generate AI videos in Claude, add Higgsfield as a custom connector with the URL [https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp](https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp), sign in to your Higgsfield account, and describe the video in a chat. Claude picks a Higgsfield model, runs the generation and returns the clip in the conversation.

- Higgsfield connects to Claude on [claude.ai](http://claude.ai/) and Claude Desktop as a custom MCP connector, and to Claude Code through the Higgsfield CLI and Skills.

The Higgsfield MCP connector is a custom connector that lets Claude generate video, images and audio with Higgsfield models directly from a chat. MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard that lets AI assistants use external tools. Higgsfield is a generative platform for creative production, with 35+ frontier models for generating images and turning them into video scenes.

- **MCP** lets Claude call Higgsfield’s tools. You connect once with the connector URL, and no API key is needed.
- **Higgsfield** runs the model and saves the result to your account. You sign in on Higgsfield’s own page, so Claude never sees your Higgsfield password.

The Higgsfield CLI and Skills are built for coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor and Codex, and Higgsfield recommends the CLI for Claude Code. Both routes use the same Higgsfield account and credits. Unlimited models and free generations from [higgsfield.ai](http://higgsfield.ai/) don’t apply to CLI generations. To set up Claude Code, send it these three commands:
`npm i -g @higgsfield/cli higgsfield auth login npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills`

Connecting Higgsfield to Claude is a one-time setup in five steps: open Customize → Connectors, add a custom connector with [https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp](https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp), sign in to Higgsfield, turn the connector on in a chat and test it. The button on [higgsfield.ai/mcp](https://higgsfield.ai/mcp?tab=claude) opens the same form in Claude with the name and URL already filled in.

**Step 2: Add a custom connector.** Click + Add, then Add custom connector. Name it Higgsfield, paste `https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp` and click Continue. Review the authentication settings Claude detects, click Continue again, then click Add.

title: How do I connect Higgsfield to Claude, ChatGPT, or another AI agent?
snippet:
Higgsfield connects to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other MCP-compatible agents, with no API key. In Claude, add a custom connector with the URL `https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp`. In ChatGPT, add the Higgsfield Plugin from the Plugins Directory. In Cursor, add Higgsfield from the marketplace. In Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Hermes, the agent installs the Higgsfield CLI. An active paid subscription is required.

Cursor,

| Agent | How it connects |
|---|---|
| Claude (claude.ai and Claude Desktop) | Custom connector with the MCP server URL |
| ChatGPT | Official Higgsfield Plugin from the Plugins Directory |
| Cursor | Higgsfield from the marketplace |
| Claude Code, OpenClaw, Hermes | Higgsfield CLI, set up by the agent itself |
| Any other MCP-compatible client | MCP server URL in the agent's settings |
## How do I connect in Claude?
1. Open [claude.ai](http://claude.ai/) or Claude Desktop and go to **Settings** → **Connectors**.
2. Click **Add custom connector**.
3. Name it Higgsfield and paste the MCP server URL: `https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp`
4. Click **Connect**: a Higgsfield authorization window opens.
5. Sign in to your Higgsfield account and authorize. If you're already logged in on [higgsfield.ai](http://higgsfield.ai/), this step is automatic.
6. Return to Claude: the Higgsfield connector appears in your active connectors list.
## How do I connect in ChatGPT?
ChatGPT uses the official Higgsfield Plugin instead of a manual URL:
1. Open the Plugins Directory in ChatGPT, or go to [higgsfield.ai/mcp](https://higgsfield.ai/mcp) and select **Add Higgsfield plugin**.
2. Find Higgsfield and select **Add**.
3. Sign in to your Higgsfield account and authorize.

These agents connect through the Higgsfield CLI, which the agent installs itself. Copy and send this message to your agent:

title: What is Higgsfield MCP, and how is it different from the web?
snippet:
Higgsfield MCP connects Higgsfield to AI agents. Connect once and generate images, videos, characters, and audio from Claude or any MCP-compatible agent, without leaving your agent. The main difference from generating on the web: MCP always uses credits. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on [higgsfield.ai](https://higgsfield.ai/), so anything generated through MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, or other automated tools deducts credits at standard rates.
## What is Higgsfield MCP?
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open protocol that lets AI agents connect to external services and call their tools. Higgsfield MCP is a connector that lets you generate images, videos, characters, and audio from Higgsfield directly inside Claude or another MCP-compatible agent. It isn't the Higgsfield API: MCP connects to your existing account and uses your existing plan credits, with no API key required. For building generation into your own product with per-request billing, see [What is the Higgsfield API, and how do I get started?](https://higgsfield.ai/creator-hub/help-center/integrations/what-is-the-higgsfield-api)
Because MCP connects programmatically, using Higgsfield through it falls under the Developer Terms in the [Terms of Use](https://higgsfield.ai/terms-of-use-agreement). In short: keep your connection secure, and you're responsible for anything an agent generates through your account.
**MCP connector URL:** [https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp](https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp)

| Criteria | Web ([higgsfield.ai](https://higgsfield.ai/)) | MCP |
|---|---|---|
| Unlimited model access | Yes, where included in plan | No, always deducts credits |
| Free generations | Yes, where included in plan | No |
| Credit cost | Standard rates | Standard rates |
| Generations appear in Assets | Yes | Yes |
| Access to models | Yes | Yes |
## Do Unlimited models and free generations work through MCP?
No. Unlimited access and free generations apply only on [higgsfield.ai](https://higgsfield.ai/): they're intended for manual use, not for automated or programmatic generation. Anything generated through MCP, CLI, Canvas, Supercomputer, or other automated tools deducts credits at standard rates. To generate on a model where your plan includes Unlimited access without spending credits, do it on the web at [higgsfield.ai](https://higgsfield.ai/).

title: MCP, CLI & Integrations
snippet:
Beyond the web app, Higgsfield runs where your pipeline runs: an MCP server for chat agents, CLI + Skills for coding agents, and official plugins for design and video tools. None of them need an API key - they connect to your existing account and use your existing plan credits.
## Higgsfield MCP
MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI agents call Higgsfield directly. Connect once and generate images, videos, characters and audio from Claude or any MCP-compatible agent without opening the app. Server URL: **https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp**
1
Add the connector
In Claude (web or Desktop): Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste https://mcp.higgsfield.ai/mcp and click Connect.
2
Authorize
Sign in to your Higgsfield account in the authorization window - if you're already logged in on higgsfield.ai, this step is automatic.
3
Verify
Ask 'What is my Higgsfield credit balance?' in a new conversation - Claude should call the MCP tools and return your account data.
Through MCP you can run image and video generation on all models, upscaling, background removal, expand/reframe, Kling Motion Control, Soul characters and reference Elements, audio (voiceover, voice cloning, dubbing), and check the credit balance. All MCP generations land in your Assets on higgsfield.ai, tagged with the MCP source.
Tip
Claude has no native credit cap - if you want control, instruct it at the start of a session: 'Before generating anything, tell me the credit cost and wait for my confirmation.'
## CLI + Skills
CLI + Skills is the integration for coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex). Where MCP exposes all tools with free parameter selection, each CLI skill has a defined structure - less token overhead, consistent output.
1
Install skills
Run npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills - it pulls three skills: generate, soul and product-photoshoot.
2
Sign in
Run higgsfield auth login. No API key needed.
3
Generate
In your coding agent, call /higgsfield:generate or just say 'Generate an image with Higgsfield' - the agent picks the skill and runs it.
- **generate** - image and video from any Higgsfield model, up to 4K; the agent selects a model automatically or you specify one.
- **soul** - train a Soul character from photos; the skill handles upload, training and naming.
- **product-photoshoot** - turn a product link or images into studio-quality product shots and video ads.
